lead: On this joyous Teachers' Day, the Department of Computer Engineering wishes to celebrate the visionary leadership and support you bring to our campus and institution every single day.
paragraphs: On this joyous Teachers' Day, the Department of Computer Engineering wishes to celebrate the visionary leadership and unwavering support you bring to our campus and institution every single day.

closing: Wishing you a very Happy Teachers' Day!
